nodes.description: Implicit storage slot 0x360894a13ba1a3210667c828492db98dca3e2076cc3735a920a3ca505d382bbc holding the implementation address used by delegatecall (EIP-1967 style). Accessed only through assembly sload/sstore.
Implicit storage slot 0xb53127684a568b3173ae13b9f8a6016e243e63b6e8ee1178d6a717850b5d6103 holding the proxy admin address. Read/updated through assembly.
Implicit storage slot 0xb53127684a568b3173ae13b9f8a6016e243e63b6e8ee1178d6a717850b5d6102 flag used to disable changeProxyAdmin once set to uint256 max.

Proxy._setImplementation(address,bytes): internal function that reads the current implementation, writes the new one, emits ProxyImplementationUpdated and optionally delegatecalls initialization data into the new implementation.
Proxy.receive(): payable external entry point that forwards to _fallback().
Proxy.fallback(): payable external entry point that forwards to _fallback().
Proxy._fallback(): internal assembly routine that loads the implementation slot, copies calldata and delegatecalls the implementation, then returns or reverts with the returned data.
TransparentProxy constructor(address implementationAddress, bytes data, address adminAddress): deploys the proxy by setting the implementation and the admin in storage.
TransparentProxy.changeImplementation(address,bytes) external, guarded by ifAdmin: allows the admin to replace the implementation and optionally run initialization data.
TransparentProxy.proxyAdmin() external view, guarded by ifAdmin: returns the current admin address.
TransparentProxy.changeProxyAdmin(address) external, guarded by ifAdmin: changes the admin unless the disable flag slot is non-zero.
TransparentProxy.disableChangeProxyAdmin() external, guarded by ifAdmin: writes uint256 max into the disabled flag slot so future admin changes are rejected.
TransparentProxy.ifAdmin() modifier: compares msg.sender to the stored admin; admin calls execute the body, non-admin calls are forwarded to _fallback().
TransparentProxy._admin() internal view: reads the admin address from assembly storage and returns it.
TransparentProxy._setAdmin(address) internal: writes the new admin address into the admin storage slot via assembly sstore.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used by the ifAdmin modifier as the access-control check against the stored admin.
delegatecall(newImplementation, data) executed inside _setImplementation: runs arbitrary code of the newly set implementation in the proxy storage context.
delegatecall(gas(), implementationAddress, ...) executed inside _fallback: forwards arbitrary calldata to the implementation in the proxy storage context.
assembly sstore writing newImplementation into the implementation storage slot without any event-independent validation.
assembly sstore writing newAdmin into the admin storage slot.
assembly sstore writing uint256 max into the disabled-flag storage slot, permanently blocking admin changes.
address newImplementation parameter of _setImplementation; stored in the implementation slot and used as delegatecall target.
bytes memory data parameter of _setImplementation; passed as calldata to the initialization delegatecall.

address adminAddress parameter of the TransparentProxy constructor, forwarded to _setAdmin.
